Here is a literature review on the topic:

Scammers continually adapt and evolve their tactics, leveraging advanced technologies to evade detection (Katz, 2019). To counter these threats, individuals and organizations must adopt proactive measures, such as implementing robust security protocols and educating themselves on emerging scams (Harrison, 2020). By staying informed and vigilant, individuals can significantly reduce their vulnerability to digital scams (Sweeney, 2018).

References:

Harrison, A. (2020). The Evolution of Scams in the Digital Age. Journal of Cybersecurity, 10(1), 1-12.

Katz, R. (2019). Scammers' Use of Artificial Intelligence to Evade Detection. Computers & Security, 84, 102-111.

Sweeney, J. (2018). The Impact of Digital Scams on Individuals and Organizations. Journal of Business Ethics, 149(2), 257-268.
